experiments.title: Genome ray-cast rasterizer: stage ablation
experiments.verdict: Adopted. Ramps + selective outline are the high-value stages; dither is mixed (per-material switch is the next test).

experiments.title: Belt update order
experiments.hypothesis: Updating belt tiles in entity-id order (upstream first for player-built lines) loses throughput because the downstream tile has not yet moved when the upstream one tries to insert.
experiments.method: qa/sim.test.mjs 'basic belt carries 7.5 items/s': 26-tile line, saturated feed, 20 s window.
experiments.verdict: Adopted downstream-first ordering (sorted by distance to chain end, then id). Matches the Factorio one-lane figure.

experiments.title: Arithmetic-only trig for cross-runtime determinism
experiments.hypothesis: Replacing Math.sin/cos with an 11-term Taylor series (after range reduction) removes the only platform-library dependence in world generation.
experiments.pending: Luau side: run `lune run tests/parity` in games/factory-universe/roblox (Lune could not be installed in the build container).

experiments.title: Sprite delivery to Roblox: runtime bake vs pre-baked palette RLE
experiments.hypothesis: Interpreted Luau is too slow to bake 180+ frames at join; shipping palette + RLE sprites as a generated module is small enough to be practical.
experiments.pending: Measure Atlas.load() and terrain bake time on a phone and in Studio (printed in the perf line).

experiments.title: Lockstep command relay instead of state replication
experiments.hypothesis: Because stateHash is deterministic, broadcasting stamped commands (bytes per action) replaces replicating thousands of belt items (bytes per tick).
experiments.pending: Two-client Studio test: desync counter stays 0 for 30 minutes; measure bandwidth.

experiments.title: All-pairs pole wires
experiments.finding: Drawing a wire for every pole pair within reach produced an unreadable tangle in the first bot-built factory screenshot (qa shot 03). Replaced with a per-network minimum spanning tree; the planner now extends from the nearest existing pole (12 poles in the seed-1 bot layout; the pre-fix count was not recorded).

experiments.title: Outlined terrain tiles
experiments.finding: Running the selective outline on ground tiles drew a dark grid over the whole map. Terrain now bakes without outlines; only rock keeps them.

experiments.title: Hazard-yellow belt chevrons
experiments.finding: Bright chevrons competed with items for attention in the zoom-6 close-up (qa shot 07), against the Shapez principle that belts stay quiet so items read. Switched to steel chevrons and 1.9x item scale.

experiments.title: No bootstrap power source
experiments.finding: The playtest bot deadlocked: the coal drill needs power to mine the coal the generator needs. Fixed by making the Core Hub a 150 kW pole (also gives new players a working first network).

backlog.title: Per-material dither switch
backlog.plan: Dither only curved/glass materials; re-run EXP-001 metrics and visual review.

backlog.title: Black-box genome fitting
backlog.plan: CMA-ES or (1+λ) search over genome parameters to match a target silhouette/colour histogram, using bake() as the renderer; compare with the human-in-the-loop lab.

backlog.title: Belt-segment aggregation (hybrid sim)
backlog.plan: Treat straight saturated runs as one queue with an offset; target 10x items at equal ms/tick; must keep stateHash semantics.

backlog.title: Neural cellular automata for material textures
backlog.class: established research (Mordvintsev et al. 2020), unverified for this use
backlog.plan: Train a small NCA offline to grow rust/heat textures; bake to ramp indices; compare against the current pattern functions.

backlog.title: Lit normal sprites for dynamic lighting
backlog.plan: Bake a normal/height buffer alongside colour from the same rays; relight at runtime for day/night and furnace glow.
